limitations_and_boundaries: Current pretraining does not inherently mitigate batch effects, so zero-shot performance may be constrained on datasets with substantial technical variation.
Evaluating the model is complex due to frequent absence of definitive biological ground truths and variation in data quality.
Pretraining data consists only of normal (non-disease) human cells, limiting direct applicability to disease states without fine-tuning.
The study does not include wet-lab validation of predicted perturbation responses or gene networks.
Performance on rare cell types is limited due to low cell numbers in reference partitions.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
